name: Santa's Winter Wonders
summary: Step into the cozy magic of Santa’s Winter Wonders, a festive spot the difference adventure wrapped in warm watercolor charm. Each level presents two Christmas scenes that look identical at first glance, but look again. Ten hidden differences, clever details, and delightful holiday surprises are tucked into every illustration. Whether you’re in the mood to relax or challenge your sharpest focus, each puzzle delivers that perfect mix of calm, curiosity, and “wait… how did I miss that?!” satisfaction. With soothing art, simple controls, and an irresistible just one more level feeling, Santa’s Winter Wonders is the perfect holiday treat for players who love puzzles, cozy vibes, and the magic of finding the smallest details.
